card.name: Findings 'indicative' or 'suggestive' of disease
card.fires_on: The words indicative or suggestive (also the 'of' right after them) when symptoms or findings are said to point to a condition, as in 'symptoms which may be indicative of ILD'.

modes.label: Indicative/suggestive
modes.description: The adjective after 'may be' or 'findings' that links symptoms or scan findings to a possible diagnosis.
modes.example: worsening or respiratory symptoms which may be<< indicative>> of ILD (e.g., dys

modes.label: Of after suggestive
modes.description: The word 'of' directly after suggestive, before the named disease.
modes.example: did not have findings suggestive<< of>> PML at the time of discontinuation
